style: Paint a brand-new scene in exactly the same art style as the reference image: a 1970s cosmic airbrush poster with smooth glowing gradients, a sunset-orange to deep-violet palette, sparkle stars, soft chrome highlights and bold retro van-art energy. Do not copy the reference's composition or objects. No people, no faces, no hands, no text, no letters, no border, no frame; the painting fills the whole canvas.

moon-new.scene: a rocky forested Atlantic shoreline on a very dark night, stars blazing, calm black water reflecting starlight. IMPORTANT: there is NO moon anywhere in the sky. Leave the upper middle of the sky open and uncluttered (soft clouds and stars only), because a moon will be added there later.
